title: After Microsoft threatened legal action, a security researcher publishes a new Windows zero-day bug | TechCrunch
summary: The new bug, dubbed ShieldBreak, is the latest disclosure by security researcher Nightmare Eclipse, who in recent months has published details of several bugs affecting Microsoft’s products, including Windows. Microsoft has not yet released a patch for the ShieldBreak bug.
